[DomainAction]
[BelongsTo<global::Showcase.Booking.BookingBoundary>]
public sealed partial class DownloadReservationAttachmentAction : DomainAction<FileResponse>
{
    private DbContext _db = null!;
    private IFileStorage _storage = null!;
    
    public required Guid ReservationId { get; init; }
    public required Guid AttachmentId { get; init; }
    
    public override async Task<Result<FileResponse, IError>> Execute(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var file = await _db.Set<ReservationAttachment>()
            .Where(e => e.Id == AttachmentId && e.ReservationId == ReservationId && !e.IsDeleted)
            .Select(e => new { e.StorageUri, e.FileName, e.ContentType, e.UploadedAt, e.Id })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (file is null)
            return Result<FileResponse, IError>.Failure(NotFoundError.For("ReservationAttachment", AttachmentId.ToString()));
        
        var content = await _storage.GetAsync(new Uri(file.StorageUri, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        
        // The row survives its blob (deleted out of band, lifecycle rule, restored DB
        // snapshot). That is a missing representation, not a server error: 404, not 500.
        if (content is null)
            return Result<FileResponse, IError>.Failure(NotFoundError.For("ReservationAttachment", AttachmentId.ToString()));
        
        return new FileResponse(content, file.ContentType, file.FileName)
        {
            ETag = file.Id.ToString("N"),
            LastModified = file.UploadedAt,
        };
    }
